en.headline: Bar Camillo opens at Rosewood Hong Kong on Wednesday with tableside Negronis
en.dek: The 50-seat Italian-inspired cocktail lounge by the Bar Leone team launches at the Tsim Sha Tsui hotel, with bookings open and service from 5pm Tuesday to Sunday.
body: Rosewood Hong Kong will open Bar Camillo on 25 November, a 50-seat cocktail bar created with Lorenzo Antinori and Justin Shun Wah of Bar Leone. The space is designed as an Italian salotto, or living room, with an emphasis on the Negroni mixed tableside from a trolley.

Guests can choose the base spirit, garnish and flavour profile before the drink is prepared at the table. The bar also features a seasonal menu that changes four times a year and a terrace overlooking the harbour. Rosewood has ranked among the world's top hotels, while Bar Leone has held the top bar ranking in recent years.

Bar Camillo will open Tuesday to Sunday from 5pm, closing at midnight on weekdays and Sunday and at 1am on Friday and Saturday. It is closed on Mondays. Bookings have been available since 1 November. The venue is located inside Rosewood Hong Kong on Salisbury Road in Tsim Sha Tsui.

zh.headline: 瑰麗酒店Bar Camillo周三開幕 設桌邊調製尼格羅尼
zh.dek: 由Bar Leone團隊打造的50座位意大利風格雞尾酒吧位於尖沙咀，周二至周日下午5時起營業，已接受預訂。
body: 香港瑰麗酒店將於11月25日開設Bar Camillo，這間50座位的雞尾酒吧由Bar Leone共同創辦人Lorenzo Antinori及Justin Shun Wah參與打造，以意大利客廳「salotto」為概念，重點是從手推車在桌邊調製的尼格羅尼。
客人可自選基酒、裝飾及風味風格，然後在桌邊調製。酒吧設有一年更換四次的季節性菜單，以及可遠眺維港的露台。瑰麗酒店近年多次位列全球頂尖酒店，Bar Leone亦曾獲全球最佳酒吧排名。
Bar Camillo周二至周日下午5時開放，平日及周日午夜結業，周五及周六則延至凌晨1時，周一休息。預訂自11月1日起開放。地址位於尖沙咀梳士巴利道瑰麗酒店內。
